description_en: You can invoke AddPersonalNumbersToUser to add one or more personal outbound numbers to a specified agent under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用AddPersonalNumbersToUser添加一个或多个个人外呼号码到指定实例下的指定坐席
kebab_example: aliyun ccc add-personal-numbers-to-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --number-list '["0101234****","0105678****"]' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddPersonalNumbersToUser

parameters.help_en: List of numbers to be added. The numbers must be attachable to the agent corresponding to UserId. If you are unsure which numbers the agent can attach, refer to the ListPersonalNumbersOfUser API
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的号码列表，要求号码可被UserId对应的坐席绑定，如果不清楚坐席可绑定哪些号码，请参考ListPersonalNumbersOfUser接口
parameters.name: number_list
